uncited: **Edge Intersection Table (`edgeTable`)**: An array of 256 integers (or shorts).

Subsequent work addressed the topological ambiguities inherent in the original 256-case table, leading to variants like the Improved Marching Cubes algorithm [9090-improved-marching-cubes-algorithm] and symmetry-based optimizations [869-symmetry-mapping].
The Watt & Watt implementation [7787-watt-watt-marching-cubes] further optimized the algorithm for large-scale data processing by addressing memory and I/O constraints.
